title: Fixed-TPKC · traditional rebound

target.description: 2-round AES-128 with initial whitening and no final MixColumns; two distinct keys yield the same complete ciphertext for a predetermined plaintext.

setting.key_relation: Two distinct attacker-chosen master keys; no secret related-key oracle.
setting.plaintext_model: One predetermined common plaintext; published witnesses use the all-zero block.
assumptions: SAT characteristic search cost is not included in the reported attack work.
Work is expected collision-generation cost; component trail probabilities are not end-to-end success.

time.note: Author expected-work estimate; no fixed-budget collision probability provided.

data.note: Offline public-cipher construction; no secret-key oracle data budget.

memory.note: Table1 has a dash, not a numerical storage bound.

success.description: The checked analysis gives an expected-work or filtering argument without a numeric probability for the complete named output event.

review.scope: PDF pp.18–19 Section4.2.1, traditional rebound complexity.

components.description: Conditional on the stated inbound/precomputed starting-point constraints; not full-budget collision-generation success.

evidence.locator: PDF pp.18–19 Section4.2.1, traditional rebound complexity.
evidence.interpretation: Defining primary-text costs, output event and conditions checked together. Independently checked against the raw source and existing QBD25 baseline; different constructions are not relabelled.

limitations: The complete named output probability is not quantified by the source.
